objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object representing a policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, or other controlled document within the system, subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The classification of the document indicating its level and purpose (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: A short code prefix used in the document name to identify its type (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: A cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number assigned per document type, included in the document name.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The descriptive title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle state of the document (e.g., Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the document, incremented upon content or relevant attribute changes.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the released document version is considered valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The calculated date until which the document remains valid, derived from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The defined time period for which a document is valid before a validity extension check is required (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The defined period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other related documents or master data objects referenced by the document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications associated with or referenced by the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational entities for which the document is relevant.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Scopes or areas to which the document applies.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: The person designated as the primary author responsible for the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned personal change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers may view the document.

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to translate released document content into other languages.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of in which clients of a multi-client system the document is visible.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the release of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the attachment, tracked independently but following the main document's release cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle state of the attachment, passing through all statuses of the main document's release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not have its own release cycle; released directly via switches in properties.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The publication state of the additional information, controlled directly via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to suggest changes to an existing released document, managed without affecting the document's current content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current processing state of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

attributes.name: editing_notes
attributes.description: Documentation by the author of the underlying document on how the change proposal was handled.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used to assign read or change authorizations and distribution roles for documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The identifying name of the user group.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: The classification of the user group (e.g., Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user in the system who can be assigned roles and authorizations on documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the person.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: The license role assigned to the person (e.g., READER, AUTHOR).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A configurable list of user groups and persons assigned to a document to receive notifications upon release, either by email or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: The type of distribution: by email notification or for active acknowledgement confirmation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise the document's validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The processing state of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate a released document and archive it, withdrawing it from circulation when it no longer has validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The processing state of the override (out-of-force) request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring its status and authorizations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The processing state of the reactivation request.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A configurable classification defining the category and level of a document, with associated templates, abbreviations, validity periods, and archive durations.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the document type (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of the document type within the document pyramid (1-4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The type abbreviation used in document naming conventions.

attributes.name: default_validity_period
attributes.description: The default period of extended validity defined for this document type.

attributes.name: default_archive_duration
attributes.description: The default archive retention period defined for this document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects, supporting standard MS Office formats and TAG technology for metadata insertion.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the document template.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The file format of the template (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process controlling the approval, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement steps for documents.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: The type of workflow (e.g., Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement, Translation Release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the workflow execution.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A documented signature captured from workflow participants during approval steps, recorded per released version for traceability.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who provided the electronic signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the signature was applied.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The step in the workflow at which the signature was provided (e.g., Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A record of a person's active confirmation of having read and noted a released document version, triggered through distribution for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

attributes.name: person
attributes.description: The person who is required to or has confirmed acknowledgement.

attributes.name: document_version
attributes.description: The version of the document for which acknowledgement is requested.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A predefined evaluation or search function providing filtered results based on selection parameters, available in role-specific variants.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the report (e.g., Status Report: Documents & Instruction, Search for Documents & Instructions).

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The role for which the report is available (e.g., Reader, Author).

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: The configurable filter criteria used to influence evaluation results.
